changeNote:
0.9.8 修复0.9.7新增的Hash校验不一致 / Fix the 0.9.7 handshake-hash regression
修正0.9.7只拦截Hash读取器的实现：游戏代码内联后可能仍读到原值，造成新版之间也无法加入。现在在编号表初始化完成后写入实际存储的协议校验值，保持所有读取途径一致，并防止重复叠加。
保留0.9.7随机数/共享遗物池完整名称同步方案。验证预编译读取、普通读取、真实Init及重复Init，以及不同编号表规模、324件遗物和完整随机数状态往返。
所有玩家请更新0.9.8并彻底退出重启。原黑屏是否完全解决仍需双机验证；不跳过原版校验。为上一版带来的连接问题致歉。
Fixes 0.9.7 intercepting only the hash getter: inlined reads could retain the original value and reject updated peers. The actual stored protocol hash is now finalized after cache initialization and applied only once per computed hash. Retains name-based RNG/shared-relic snapshots. Tested precompiled/direct reads, real initialization/reinitialization and complete snapshot round trips. ALL peers should update to 0.9.8 and fully restart. The original black-screen mitigation still requires two-PC confirmation; native validation is not bypassed. Sorry for the connection regression.
